params.$select: unique_key, created_date, complaint_type, descriptor, descriptor_2, location_type, address_type, facility_type, borough, city, incident_zip, open_data_channel_type, agency, status, closed_date, resolution_description, resolution_action_updated_date
params.$where: lower(complaint_type) = 'heat/hot water' and created_date >= '2024-01-27T00:00:00' and created_date < '2024-01-28T00:00:00'

ordering: $order=unique_key, single page; $limit 5000 exceeded the 798 rows so no paging
limitation: one calendar day, the lowest-volume heat day of Jan-2024; not a sample of the month and no surge behaviour in it
